title: SimpleDiscordCommand
description: A simple discord command using /discord. Very small and configurable.
body:
A simple- **6KB**- plugin that allows sends a player a customized message when they type /discord.

You can change the message using the config.

**What it looks like:**

![Default message.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07c79b8e3da060905f4907a9062cc16a6415f051_0.webp)

**Config file:**

![Default config.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f358862ce0a82b12216c2e41cb9fdef4388b7cd1.png)

**Permission node:**
```
simplediscordcommand.use
```
Feel free to use this on your server- don't worry about credit etc.

*(Does not matter what the size of your server is.)*
